properties.title: About the workflow
properties.content:
Create a Character Dataset

Upload one image of a character and a list of views, and the model generates a matching set of images you can use to train a LoRA. That's it.

Open source, so you only pay for generation time.
All models pre-loaded on Floyo.

Model

  • Qwen Image Edit 2509 by Alibaba Qwen. An open source image editing model with strong identity preservation across edits.
  • Qwen Image Lightning LoRA. Cuts generation down to a few steps for speed.

Heavy workflow. Generating a full set takes time.

properties.title: Inputs you need
properties.content:
Character image

  • One clear image of the character you want a dataset of. Their identity is kept across every image.

Prompt list

  • One prompt per line, each describing a view, angle, or setting. The model makes one image per line.

Character name

  • A name or word for your character. It is saved with each image as the training caption.
Add an image and your prompts, hit run.

properties.title: Settings
properties.content:
All optional. Defaults work well.
  • Steps: (default: 4). How many passes the model makes per image. The Lightning LoRA keeps this low.
  • Resolution: (default: 1 megapixel). The size of each generated image.
  • Guidance: (default: 1). How closely each image follows the prompt.
  • Seed: (default: fixed). A number that controls the randomness. Keep it fixed for a consistent set, change it for variety.
